section.heading: Jurisdiction.

para.text: Subject to subsection (b) of this section, the Family Court shall have jurisdiction to enter a SOUL Family order and shall retain jurisdiction to modify a SOUL Family order until the youth reaches 21 years of age; provided, that, when the youth reaches 18 years of age, the youth consents and the Family Court finds it is in the best interest of the youth.
A youth who exits foster care to a SOUL Family may not reenter foster care after age 18.

section.codify:annotation: Applicability of D.C. Law 26-159: § 4 of D.C. Law 26-159 provided that the creation of this section by § 2(c) of D.C. Law 26-159 is subject to the inclusion of the law’s fiscal effect in an approved budget and financial plan. Therefore that amendment has not been implemented.
